# HeadPain

> Map head pain on an interactive 3D head: tell concurrent pains apart by colour and shape, record what the pain costs you, and hand someone a read-only page or an embeddable widget that explains it, all in the browser

- Live: https://headpain.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: health, 3d, pain, diary, localstorage, embed, education
